text:
L7CHECK::protocol
Description
This command allows you to set or retrieve L7 protocol value.
Syntax
L7CHECK
::
protocol
set
<
VALUE
>
L7CHECK
::
protocol
get
Examples
when
L7CHECK_CLIENT_DATA
{
if
{
[
L7CHECK
::
protocol
get
]
==
"https"
}
{
pool
clients_https
}
else
{
pool
clients_non_https
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CONNECTOR_OPEN (v16.1+ only)
L7CHECK_CLIENT_DATA
L7CHECK_SERVER_DATA
Introduced: BIGIP-14.0.0
Updated: BIGIP-16.1.0 (added CONNECTOR_OPEN event)
